Also, I'll have a test program for you to run in a bit.

Okay thanks for that info.
Regarding the other problem; I'm not sure if I should make another issue for this, but glfwGetMonitors is returning NULL even if there is a "headless/fake" desktop without a physical monitor connected, this might be correct functionality but I am not certain. As far as I know, that issue can only occur on Windows and the current behaviour is not ideal. VMware triggers the same issue.
